title: Depot on your phone
intro: Open Depot in your phone's web browser and sign in as usual. The screen rearranges itself to fit.

sections.heading: Home on a phone
text: The left rail becomes a row of buttons under the search box. Swipe it sideways to see them all.
steps: Tap your initials in the top right corner to open your account menu.
Tap **Switch light / dark theme** to change how Depot looks.

sections.heading: Add a photo
text: Tap **Files** in the row of buttons under the search box to see your files.
steps: Tap **Upload files**. Your phone then lets you pick a photo, take a new one, or choose a file.
